dedupe_keys.name: winsrfr surface irrigation hydraulic analysis software usda ars

description: WinSRFR is a hydraulic analysis tool for surface irrigation systems from the USDA Agricultural Research Service. Its simulator predicts surface and subsurface water flow as a function of system geometry, infiltration, hydraulic resistance and inflow management, and the software adds evaluation, operational analysis and design functions. Version 5.1 (September 2019) added Green-Ampt furrow infiltration, Richards-equation border infiltration, the EVALUE component to estimate infiltration and roughness, and advective-dispersive fertigation simulation; 5.1.1 fixed fertigation errors. Intended users are irrigation specialists, extension agents, researchers, consultants, students and farmers. Coverage is any furrow, border or basin field. It is a free download from the ARS site after a short form. Caveats: the release dates from 2019, some fertigation dispersion results can still oscillate near blocked downstream ends, and the licence is not stated on the download page. Simulation uses: design and operation of furrow, border and basin irrigation and planning of scheme capacity. Related records: LANID irrigation maps (data-lanid-landsat-irrigation-dataset-us) and WEAP (platform-sei-weap-water-evaluation-and-adaptation-planning).
inputs: Field geometry, infiltration, hydraulic resistance and inflow management of furrows, borders or basins
